item.title: Pyrkon Festival: Interactive Mixed Reality Booth (2025–2026)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: Showcasing bespoke Mixed Reality (MR) and VR educational applications at one of Europe’s largest pop culture festivals — Pyrkon.

item.title: Zero-Trust AI: Securing Sensitive Data Through Local-Only Processing (OCETA Lounge 2026)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: A talk at OCETA Lounge detailing Zero-Trust AI architectures – processing sensitive biometric and telemetry data entirely on-device using Ollama and local open-weight LLMs.

item.title: Biofeedback & Multisensory Immersion in VR (Master's Thesis)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An R&D environment investigating physiological correlations between human biometrics and subjective VR/PC flow states, featuring ESP32 telemetry, a custom Olfactory Display, and Python data science.

item.title: HARDWARE SOVEREIGNTY: Creating Custom Devices with AI Agents (OCETA Connect 2026)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: A talk and discussion panel at OCETA Connect on engineering bespoke embedded devices using AI agents to achieve complete data security and hardware independence.

item.title: New Technology Days: Multi-Year Innovation Festival (2019–2026)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: Co-organizing every edition of New Technology Days: hands-on hardware workshops, 3D printing labs, Unity demos, and connecting high schoolers with university research.

item.title: Experiencing Immersion in Virtual Realities & Techniques for Deepening Presence (OCETA 2025)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: A conference talk delivered at OCETA exploring embodied presence in XR, physiological biometric measurements of immersion, and practical techniques for spatial depth.

item.title: WST / XR BINIU - Autonomous AI Drones & Sim2Real
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An open-source framework connecting Unity 6 physics simulations, reinforcement learning (ML-Agents), and ESP32 controllers over LTE/VPN for autonomous unmanned vehicles.

item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An advanced cooperative VR spaceship simulator (LAN Multiplayer / Netcode) paired with clinical biometric research measuring player stress (EDA) and presence in VR.

item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)

item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: Behind the scenes of organizing Pestka Jam with the Errno science club – 72 hours of intensive prototyping, technical mentoring, and game production.

item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An open-source classroom simulation in Virtual Reality (physics, astronomy, geology, hardware engineering) funded by Kowadło 2.0 and deployed across schools in Poland.

item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: A case study detailing Propaganda Studios’ indie booth at PGA 2021: welcoming hundreds of players, gathering real-time feedback, and shipping overnight bug fixes.

item.title: Where It All Started - Anthropological Reconstruction & 3D Printing

item.description: An interdisciplinary scientific project reconstructing the skulls of early inhabitants of Greater Poland using FDM 3D printing, cutting production costs 15-fold, presented at Poznań City Hall.
